reviews.title: Don’t Touch Anything!!
reviews.text: Don’t use this software!! This program sucks. If you use this app while on a computer, you cannot touch anything else on your computer while the program is taking notes otherwise the program stops recording despite the counter still running. If you use the app on your phone, turn off everything here too as you will lose the recording (especially if your phone has auto-locking capabilities). I hate that I spent money to get the Pro version too otherwise I’d already be using another program.

reviews.title: Collects Information, doesn’t produce the results without paying.
reviews.text:
Why sit and pretend what you advertise and do mot produce the results without paying for your subscription? 

Don’t advertise something, collect peoples information, then throw up your sorry non-disclosed paywall! 
Thats dirty! 
Hope you feel good about yourself! 
Do not sell my information and delete everything tied to my username! Respond to this review with your confirmation of said deletions.

reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: Having paid for a whole year it's beyond disappointing to me that there are glitches and then a very poor customer service that begins but then goes nowhere.

reviews.title: За деньги не работает
reviews.text: Я оплатила подписку на месяц. Но аудио в текст не сделало. Постоянно в режиме загрузке файла. Аудио 20 мин . Возможности написать в поддержку нет . Просто не активна кнопка .

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text:
I purchased a monthly subscription on April 29, but by May 26 the app stopped working. On what basis was my subscription disabled before the month even ended?

Customer support is completely useless and does not respond at all. This is a terrible app with very poor service. I do not recommend Transkriptor to anyone.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: Free to download and use up storage, but you need a subscription to actually use any of the apps functionality. And it doesn’t let you know this until after you give them your email to make an account.

reviews.title: Didn’t even get the teachers speech into there, just me whispering with my classmate
reviews.text: I need help hearing, not because I have bad hearing, but because I need slight help with translating stuff from Spanish to English, so I was wondering if I could use this to put down what the teacher was saying, what did it put down? Absolutely nothing, just some words I’m assuming it put down out of nowhere

reviews.title: What free trial?!! False advertising
reviews.text: There was a 7-day free trial, and I canceled it within the first 30 minutes. They’re still billing me for a full month. This is 100% false advertising & poor customer service.
